scope: Actual HMAC signed organization issue edit/assigned/unassigned/closed/reopened events pass the production signature gate and durable inbox before native GitHub fixture fetch.
Native assignee/state changes remain distinct from frozen controlled assignment, contract and policy history.
All4 evaluationKind scopes are immutable challenge metadata and produce their matching controlled category labels.
21same-author same-repository reports in one hour trigger reversible possible-spam and possible-duplicate moderation flags without approval, recognition or challenge assignment.
Signed PR opened -> evaluating; organizer REOPENED -> in-progress; closed/reopened submission retains evaluation history and frozen assignment; blocked availability prevents assignment.
Exclusive reservation expiry releases capacity and allows fresh assignment while retaining expired frozen policy history.
Existing concurrent shared/exclusive claim and7reservation activation tests pass in the same focused run.
Bug/feature/performance/clarification source templates have mandatory fields; fixture native markdown enters advisory triage, never automatically creates an authoritative contract.
productionLimits: GitHub API responses and account identities are controlled fixtures; signatures use a local synthetic App webhook secret.
Evaluation scope metadata is verified for all4categories; this does not prove organizer event scoring policy for OPTIONAL/BONUS submissions.
Templates are supplied in Judge-C2C source and tested with representative markdown; deployment/native rendering in every challenge repository is not claimed.
Spam control is a reversible per-author/per-repository reporting flag, not account-wide ingestion throttling or semantic gaming detection.
Finite lifecycle sequences, concurrency races and reservation recovery are covered; every possible external GitHub event permutation remains outside this evidence.
